listing.name: Wii Party — Wii Party Recomp (arelkair) (arelkair)
listing.summary: The alpha is claimed to complete Board Game Island and all 79 Free Play minigames. Other modes and a real sensor bar remain incomplete. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own ISO, WBFS, RVZ, CISO, WIA or GCM. The recorded source observation refers to PAL60, but this guide does not specify the exact supported serial number or revision. Check the project’s requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released single-file launcher to build locally. The offline tools ZIP is optional.

warnings: The alpha is claimed to complete Board Game Island and all 79 Free Play minigames. Other modes and a real sensor bar remain incomplete.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
